0022600170.text: The Golden State Warriors (4-3, second in the Pacific and 9th in the West) host the Phoenix Suns (1-3, third in the Pacific and 12th in the West) with the Warriors riding a four-game winning streak and the Suns on a two-game losing skid. Golden State will be without Stephen Curry and Draymond Green (both resting), Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody (both recovering from knee surgery), and Kristaps Porzingis (illness), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
